company.name: Corelight
company.shortDescription: Corelight is a cybersecurity company specializing in network traffic analysis (NTA) solutions.
company.description:
Corelight offers network traffic analysis solutions for cybersecurity. It helps security professionals to understand network traffic and to detect and stop cyberattacks. Its solution was built on Bro, a widely-used open-source framework that provides a real-time understanding of network traffic.

The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A network detection and response platform that converts on-premises, cloud, and hybrid network traffic into evidence for threat detection, investigation, threat hunting, and response.
productsAndServices.name: Corelight Open NDR Platform

productsAndServices.description: Network traffic sensors that collect and analyze traffic from physical, cloud, virtual, and software-defined environments, producing Zeek-based network evidence for security and operations teams.
productsAndServices.name: Corelight Sensors

productsAndServices.description: A SaaS-based network detection and response application for evidence-first alert triage, investigation, threat hunting, and incident response.
productsAndServices.name: Corelight Investigator

productsAndServices.description: A multilayer detection capability combining signatures, threat intelligence, behavioral analytics, machine learning, anomaly detection, and MITRE ATT&CK-aligned detections.
productsAndServices.name: Corelight Analytics & Detections

productsAndServices.description: A network-based visibility product that passively classifies assets and identifies anomalous network performance using data collected by Corelight Sensors.
productsAndServices.name: Corelight Performance & Asset Visibility

productsAndServices.description: A packet-capture capability that selectively stores traffic relevant to investigations, extending the historical evidence available for threat detection and forensic analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Corelight Smart PCAP

aiResearchSummary.text: Corelight is researching methods for analyzing network traffic, specifically focusing on identifying authentication methods within secure shell (SSH) data. The work described in 'System and method for identifying authentication method of secure shell (ssh)' details a process where a processor receives SSH session data and detects communication patterns related to SSH authentication. This highlights Corelight’s focus on network traffic analysis and secure authentication detection.
